Off Grid AI

📌

Every AI app I tried wanted my data on its computer. My notes, my meetings, my inbox. That was the price of an answer.

Phones and laptops are now fast enough that the price is optional.

Off Grid AI runs the models on hardware you already own: [...] Off Grid AI runs the models on hardware you already own:

 Phone: chat, documents, photos, voice and image generation. Works with the Wi-Fi off. No account.
 Computer: all of that, plus a memory of your day. Meetings are transcribed on your machine, with no bot in the call. Ask "what did I promise Sam?" and you get the answer with its source.
 Actions: it drafts the email, the ticket, the invite. Nothing goes out until you approve it.
 Sync: your phone can use your Mac's bigger models, device to device. No server of ours in between.
 Developers: one OpenAI-compatible API on your own machine for every model you download.

The free app is open source: github.com/off-grid-ai/OGAM. 250,000+ downloads and 3,300+ stars so far. The code is the privacy policy. [...] Subscribe

Off Grid AI runs AI models on the phone and computer you already own. Chat, read documents, ask about photos, talk out loud and make images, with the Wi-Fi off and no account. On your computer it remembers your day: meetings transcribed with no bot in the call, answers that cite their source, and replies it drafts but only sends after your yes. Your phone can use your Mac's bigger models, device to device. Free and open source on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux.
